assembly.topology: Two ROBOTIS Dynamixel MX-106 actuators driving a common shaft through a 24:55 external spur gear pair.
assembly.joint_or_axis: Humanoid hip-roll bench assembly; lever arm 300 mm from axis to load centre.

excluded_components: instrumented per-actuator output torque sensors (not present)
system_boundary.notes: The tested actuators are different units of the same model and gear ratio as the retired deployed platform; the original robot was not on the bench.

controller_sync.command_mode: Position control; one synchronized write to both actuators and one bulk read per record.
controller_sync.firmware_config_state: Both units reported model 320 and firmware 41. Post-test readback gave D=0, I=0, P=32; per-run gain history is not complete. Address 29 is undocumented for this model.

test_conditions.cooling_boundary: Still laboratory air; ambient temperature not recorded. No separate forced cooling stated.
test_conditions.initial_state_policy: Static hold trials were predeclared to start below 40 degC; actual starts were 25-35 degC. Initial device-temperature matching target was 2 degC. The hot-start/cooldown sequence is recorded by run, not reduced to one common state.
conditions_notes: Supply was set to 14.8 V and read 14.7-14.9 V unloaded; loaded runs show additional voltage variation.
Raw logging rates differ by experiment: 50 Hz for holds, 500 Hz for constant-rate traverses, and approximately 1000 Hz for maximum-speed runs.
Temperature is the internal device reading at register address 43; no external surface/winding sensor was fitted.
Static holds stop if either actuator reports 70 degC or the angle-abort criterion is met. The 600 s target, 1.0 deg tolerance, 0.5 s dwell and 40 degC start ceiling were prespecified 2026-09-19.
Downhill tests caused regenerative bus overvoltage on a supply that could not sink current; such attempts were excluded and are retained in the run ledger.

scope_notes: Run ledger breakdown: static 16 attempted / 11 included / 5 excluded; max-speed 9 / 4 / 5; dynamic 18 / 9 / 9; tuning 3 / 0 / 3; no-load 3 / 2 / 1.
The author repository README reports 49 attempted runs and 48 raw logs. One excluded high-load static run group refers to a deleted source file.
Validity/inclusion is not equivalent to task pass: thermal-stop runs are retained as valid measured outcomes.

identified_parameter_groups: common-shaft output speed at sampled loads
applied gravity moment from weighed masses and lever arm
per-actuator internal temperature and electrical register observations
confounded_parameter_groups: individual actuator torque constant and torque output
mechanical_share_observability.identifiability_method: The two actuators drive one common shaft, but no independent torque transducer is fitted to each path. The four-point loaded-speed fit identifies only n_a * beta * eta * tau_s = 21.22 N m; it cannot separate actuator stall torque, efficiency and load sharing. A 0.68-0.70 current fraction does not identify torque share.
mechanical_share_observability.reason: The paper explicitly states that inferring beta approximately 0.71-0.74 assumes equal torque constants, equal individual allowable outputs, and persistence of the current split at the relevant operating point. Those assumptions were not independently verified.

notes: Source run ledger states two attempts on 2026-09-25 with angle abort at 0.5 s, two further attempts at gain 128 with actuator 48 dropout, and two attempts on 2026-09-27. A 600 s 2026-09-27 hold with 0.575 deg droop and 21.9% Load2 was excluded by the author because it settled at the low end of the static-friction band. The associated file was deleted; this is an aggregate exclusion record, not six separately reconstructed runs.

evidence.method: Published methods/results and the paper's reported loaded-speed and static-hold tables.
Public source repository containing bench acquisition/analysis code, run ledger, setup record and 48 raw logs under MIT license.
Run-by-run ledger parsed independently: 49 rows, 26 marked valid/included and 23 invalid/excluded.
Raw maximum-speed trace; independently reprocessed by OLS encoder angle versus logged timestamp over |q|<=8 deg for three repetitions. Git blob SHA c5086fc2d0934623aeeda97802f434d8cf99bd9e.

claim_ceiling: Source-derived bench characterization of one MX-106 actuator pair on a 24:55 common-shaft hip-roll rig. Independently recomputed speed means use the same author's raw logs and are not an independent physical replication. Per-actuator mechanical torque share is not identifiable. Static-hold performance includes static gear-train friction. Not gait performance, universal actuator capacity, pair-level safety qualification, or a transferable beta correction factor.
notes: The 300 mm lever has an equivalent mass of 0.3622/0.3874/0.3892 kg for boxes A/B/C. Applied moments are 11.7275, 17.5904 and 23.3934 N m; empty lever is 1.1454 N m.
A single-direction static resisting torque of 0.61 N m was measured for the mounted gear train. It is not a bidirectional running-friction or hysteresis map.

The no-load upper speed was estimated as 2.618 rad/s. Maximum loaded speeds were 1.9688, 1.6719 and 1.3653 rad/s at 11.7275, 17.5904 and 23.3934 N m; high-load result is 47.8% below the no-load bound.

At the heaviest load, thermal-stop runs ended at 332.9, 350.6 and 394.3 s when actuator 48 reported 70 degC; in the run with both terminal values, actuator 9 was 52 degC (18 degC difference). The paper reports the partner was 51-52 degC and the delta 18-19 degC.
Across SF 1.52 and 2.02 holds, the hotter unit's median share of measured pair current was 0.68-0.70. Store this as electrical effort evidence only, not mechanical torque sharing.

A-C-1-del is retained as an aggregate exclusion note. The author says the file was deleted because the 600 s run settled at the low end of the static-friction band and the motors carried less of the load.

Independent raw-log reconstruction rule: per repetition, regress joint angle (radians) on logged timestamps within |q|<=8 deg and take absolute slope. Reconstructed means: A=1.9687573674 rad/s, B=1.6718757964 rad/s, C=1.3653467243 rad/s, empty=2.5781276294 rad/s. These agree with the paper's displayed means; computation is independent, underlying measurement is not.
